articles.title: Nakamura Ward Office Complex / Takenaka Corporation
articles.summary: Four ward facilities (ward office, public works office, healthcare center, city tax office) have been brought together on the site of a former elementary school. The local government facilities and the private sector facilities have been arranged around an open space with the aim that it can continue to be used for the Bon festival dances and sports that were performed at the elementary school site.

articles.title: What Does It Take to Start a Career in Architecture?
articles.summary: An architecture degree provides the foundations of the discipline, but the transition into professional practice often extends well beyond the classroom. Building experience, developing a portfolio, and navigating the realities of architectural offices are challenges that many graduates face in their first years of practice.

articles.title: Zhuozhuo Community / WEI+ Design
articles.summary: Located in the heart of the Taoyangli Historic District in Jingdezhen , Zhuozhuo Community is an urban regeneration project that transforms a collection of existing buildings, residential structures, and traditional alleyways into an open, multifunctional cultural community. Situated between Zhongshan North Road, a historic commercial street dating back approximately 600 years, and the Imperial Kiln archaeological site, Taoyangli preserves the layered urban fabric of Jingdezhen's ceramic heritage. articles.title: Civic Campus Sallarès Deu / JAAS
articles.summary: Architecture studio JAAS — led by Josep M. Julià, Albert Clèries, Jordi Gorgues, and Manuel Julià — presents Sallarès Deu, the transformation of the former textile factory of the same name, originally designed in 1920 by architect Lluís Muncunill, into a new civic campus in the heart of Sabadell , near Barcelona. Commissioned by the City Council of Sabadell, the project reinterprets the city's industrial heritage through a contemporary approach that combines historical continuity, environmental responsibility, and new civic uses.

articles.title: Brumadinho Memorial / Gustavo Penna Arquiteto e Associados
articles.summary: The Brumadinho Memorial, designed by Gustavo Penna Arquitetos Associados (GPAA), honors the 272 victims of the Córrego do Feijão mine dam collapse in Brumadinho, Minas Gerais. Located at the site of the tragedy, the project was born from the mobilization of the victims' families and was co-developed with them to provide space for mourning, preserve personal histories, and establish a space for reflection, education, and resistance against forgetting.

articles.title: Casa Emilio Delporte / Citic
articles.summary: Casa Emilio Delporte emerges as an architectural journey rooted in the biology of love, recognizing that a true home is a dwelling in harmony between its inhabitants and the ecological niche that embraces them. This regeneration project transforms a historic work by architect Luciano Kulczewski—originally designed in 1929 within the Arturo Prat Cooperative Housing in Providencia , Santiago—into a "house for conversation."

articles.title: Padre Luís Cabral Building / Hori-zonte
articles.summary: In Porto , a three-story residential building integrates passive strategies into its very layout, balancing solar orientation, cross-ventilation, privacy, and a connection with nature.

articles.title: Wild Pond Villa / L. McComber
articles.summary: Following the complete demolition of her modest 1970s cottage, ravaged by fire, a Montrealer set out to rebuild her country retreat with a Mediterranean spirit, embracing the peaceful landscape of this corner of the Eastern Townships. The challenge was a significant one : preserving the original footprint to maintain the existing rights within the shoreline protection zone.

articles.title: Wilnsdorf Primary School and Sports Hall / BUERO BB
articles.summary: Set into a wooded slope in western Germany, Wilnsdorf Primary School combines timber, regional precast concrete, and concrete recycled from a demolished local viaduct into a compact building for learning.
